summary: Two-story frame cabin dated 1934 on Gant Mountain, Lemhi County, ID (Salmon NF); listed gone by 1970; one known staff name (1939); no current site description found.

facts.design: Two-story frame cabin on the northernmost point of the mountain
facts.status_note: Two sources give 1970 as the year it was gone; Forest Lookouts marks it removed with no date; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes a trail or current access

events.note: Listed as a two-story frame cabin dated 1934; no builder is named in the sources
Joseph O Gjertson listed as known staff, citing a former Forest Fire Lookout Registry
Forest Service notice dated July 19, 1951, quoted from The Recorder Herald, proposing to sell, donate, abandon or destroy a 2-mile spur telephone line to Gant Lookout; the cabin is not named
Listed as gone in 1970; the sources do not say how the cabin came down

evidence.supports: two-story frame cabin dated 1934, atop the northernmost point

evidence.quote: July 19, 1951: The Forest Service proposes to sell, donate, abandon or destroy on or after August 16, 1951, the following property: 2 mile spur telephone line to Gant Lookout. (The Recorder Herald)

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: status gone, kind two_story, agency Salmon National Forest all agree with the sources; access stays unknown, so no access key. Elevation 8,276 ft appears in sources 1 and 2 but the schema has no elevation key, so it appears only in the story. The 1951 notice concerns a telephone line, not the cabin; do not read it as a demolition order. The sources do not say how the cabin came down, so the event is 'removed' and not 'destroyed'. Two WebSearch calls and six distinct pages read (the Forest Lookouts page was re-grepped, not re-read); the Salmon-Challis fire lookouts page and the Salmon forest history did not mention Gant. No site-today description found.
